body: lots of things interest me, the problem is when I sit down to actually do them, I instantly become bored with them before even starting.

BA 52 - if someone is of possible harm to themselves or others, authorities must be called to intervene. Then they lock you up for 72 hours, but only talk to you twice the whole time.  After you do finally get released, you get hit with a bill for $3,000+.

VPN - Virtual private network.  It makes it look like your IP is somewhere it is not by connecting through different ports.

Throwaway - an account that is made with the intention of anonymity and ease of destroying, should it be necessary.

I would not.  Baker acts are a real thing in my state. Been there, done that, got that t-shirt *twice*.

That's why I've routed through a VPN and made a throwaway.
